# ADMR — Q2 2026 Equity Analysis

**Adaro Minerals Indonesia (ADMR)** delivered a softer quarter as coking-coal ASPs normalised from the prior-year peak. Prior context: [[ADMR Q1 2026 Analysis]] and the sector read-through in [[Coal Sector — 2026 Outlook]].

## Key Financials

| Metric              | Q2 2026 | Q1 2026 | Q2 2025 | Δ QoQ  |
| ------------------- | ------- | ------- | ------- | ------ |
| Revenue (IDR bn)    | 6,120   | 6,480   | 7,930   | -5.6%  |
| EBITDA (IDR bn)     | 2,210   | 2,470   | 3,540   | -10.5% |
| Net income (IDR bn) | 1,180   | 1,410   | 2,260   | -16.3% |
| P/BV (x)            | 1.9     | 2.1     | 2.8     | -0.2   |
| ROE (%)             | 14.2    | 16.8    | 24.1    | -2.6pp |

## Risks

- **HIGH** — Coking-coal price volatility remains the dominant earnings swing factor.
- **MODERATE** — Fuel and overburden stripping cost inflation pressures margins.
- **LOW** — Balance sheet stays in net cash (IDR 3.1tn), limiting financial risk.
